name: Flexible solar panel Yinleader CSSF-100W-CPC, 690 x 855 x 1.5 mm, 100 W

electrical.note: label values (Yinleader, the default model); other sizes scale W, Imp, Isc with the area (Voc and Vmp stay)

ren.label: Renogy 100W Black Division
ren.note: 1092 x 582 x 2.5 mm (43 x 22.9 x 0.1 in), flexible to 240 degrees, 36 PERC cells 12 x 3, 12 AWG MC4 leads

holes.note: metal grommets, 3 on each long side (6 total); positions APPROXIMATE, measure the real panel. A panel is bolted through a row of holes (end, middle, end) onto each of 3 bars at the hole pitch, about 402 mm for the default size

mounts.note: origin = centre of the bottom face; lies on the rack bars; yaw in 90 degree steps

accepts.note: MC4 plug tip of the panel + lead
MC4 plug tip of the panel - lead

model.label: Model
model.note: choosing a model sets the size and the electrical numbers (electrical.models); the size can be changed afterwards

width.label: Panel width
width.note: the mounting border and the corner radius keep their size, the cell area grows

length.label: Panel length
length.note: the junction box and leads sit at the +Z end and follow it

slide.label: Slide
slide.note: moves the panel along its own width axis (older scenes; Move sets px and pz instead)

px.label: Along the car
px.note: offset from the slot along the car, in the rack frame; set by Move (snaps the hole rows to the bars)

pz.label: Across the car
pz.note: offset from the slot across the car, in the rack frame; set by Move

bolted.label: Bolted
bolted.note: bolt heads show only while the hole rows sit over bars (the page sets this)

outline.note: selection box = the panel body; the junction box and leads hang past the end and are left out

estimated: ESTIMATES: corner radius 17 mm, mounting border 36 mm along the long sides and 22 mm at the ends (grommets 15 mm from the long edge, inside the border), cell layout 4 x 5 cells of about 150 x 160 mm with cut corners, 2.5 mm gaps and 9 busbars each. Surface: flexible ETFE laminate, semi-matte with a fine pebble texture (runtime normal map, low specular), black monocrystalline cells. The founder may send a photo of the real panel to correct these.
notes: 1.5 mm thick, 1.2 kg. ETFE laminate over a black backsheet, rounded corners, wide mounting border with the grommets, black monocrystalline cells (4 x 5, nine busbars each) inside the cell area; junction box 90 x 60 x 15 mm on the back with two 220 mm leads ending in MC4 plugs. The + lead is male and the - lead female as briefed (verify on the real panel).
